content.title: Western Digital (NASDAQ:WDC) Q4 Sales Beat Estimates, Inventory Levels Improve
content.summary: Leading data storage manufacturer Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC) reported Q4 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 25.2% year on year to $3.02 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($3.2 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 6.8% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.13 per share was 10.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
